## Critique
- claim-1: Correct. Supplying executable code without a sandbox execution is not computation evidence. No task-owned artifact ID, captured stdout/stderr, exit status, or stable digest was returned.
- claim-2: Correct as the status of this repair. Earlier accepted evidence supports the rank calculation and conditional minimality argument, but cannot replace the expressly required new task-owned computation artifact. Thus the named capability certificate remains unestablished; this does not refute the mathematical corollary.

## Repair certificates
- [computation] Execute verbatim the self-contained script in the Specialist Output with its embedded inputs. Its assertions must verify degreewise free ranks \(1,1,2,1,1\) in degrees \(4,\ldots,8\), zero in degrees \(9,\ldots,32\), no torsion, and total rank \(6\). Persist the executable code, explicit inputs, complete stdout/stderr, exit status \(0\), script/output digests, and a new task-owned artifact digest.

## Required revisions
- Return the resulting task-owned artifact identifier and digests. Only after successful execution may the output conclude \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\) and apply accepted generation and indexed-family Nakayama to the two six-element families, proving their case-specific \(i=j=p=2,c=6\) minimality. Do not claim any broader theorem.
